_comment: Pinned model assets for scripts/fetch_models.py (CP2, G-PROV). Nothing here is downloaded automatically:
an operator runs the script explicitly. Values come from docs/OVERSIGHT_CP2.md section 2 and docs/LICENSES.md
section 2a (oversight agent, 2026-10-08): @mediapipe/tasks-vision pinned at 1.0.1 (B-06, D-014); every sha256
below was computed by Oversight from the registry tarball tasks-vision-1.0.1.tgz whose dist.integrity matched,
so any mirror of the per-file URL is acceptable only because the script verifies that hash.
hand_landmarker.task keeps sha256 null: its licence is UNVERIFIED (B-05, C-03) and a human must read the model
card and hash the artifact on the laptop (docs/OVERSIGHT_CP2.md section 2, human steps) before filling it.
The script refuses any entry whose sha256 or url is null or whose base file name has no VERIFIED-COMMERCIAL
row naming its licence in docs/LICENSES.md. Keys the script reads: name, version, url, sha256, licence;

assets.name: hand_landmarker.task
assets.notes: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker model bundle (palm detector + hand landmarks), canonical float16/1 artifact (never /latest/). Licence UNVERIFIED in docs/LICENSES.md until a human quotes the model card; sha256 stays null until computed on the laptop. The server shows this entry's version in the camera UI.

assets.name: vision_bundle.mjs
assets.notes: ESM bundle of @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0.1 (the HandLandmarker runtime); package/vision_bundle.mjs in the registry tarball, 155,439 bytes. Contains the odml telemetry logger, blocked by the app's CSP connect-src 'self'. Served as text/javascript.

assets.name: vision_wasm_internal.js
assets.notes: WASM loader (SIMD build); package/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js, 323,377 bytes. Stored flat here because the worker looks it up by bare file name.

assets.name: vision_wasm_internal.wasm
assets.notes: WASM binary (SIMD build) matching vision_wasm_internal.js; package/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm, 11,756,954 bytes. Served as application/wasm.

assets.name: vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.js
assets.notes: Optional fallback loader for browsers without WebAssembly SIMD; package/wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.js, 323,180 bytes. Omit with --only if not wanted; the worker then reports the missing fallback honestly.

assets.name: vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.wasm
assets.notes: Optional fallback binary for the no-SIMD runtime; package/wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.wasm, 10,960,242 bytes.
